# Phase 5 — Component Model Adequacy & Complexity Ablation

Decision: TIMESNET_FAILURE_NOT_EXPLAINED_BY_CAPACITY
Bottleneck: MULTI_COMPONENT_REDESIGN_REQUIRED

## Protocol
REAL_ONLY; component window=10; first 20% train and next 20% validation; B0007/B0018; five fixed seeds.
Fixed optimization: lr=0.001, batch_size=32, patience=50, weight_decay=1e-05. Every fit has <=16 windows, therefore uses one batch without changing the batch-size ceiling.
TestLoaded=false for every run: raw CSV was read with nrows=ValidationEnd.
No GAN, fusion, transfer, calibration, sequence grid, epsilon grid, or test set was used.
PERSISTENCE_RECURSIVE is the deployable T0 and never reads validation component labels. PERSISTENCE_ONE_STEP_DIAGNOSTIC and SOH_PERSISTENCE_ONE_STEP_DIAGNOSTIC use the true prior validation observation only as explicitly labelled historical diagnostic references.
